Visualizations

Lyric Word Count by Decade

Lyric word count distribution by decade

There is a clear and consistent decline in lyric word count from 1980s to 2020s.

When zooming out, we can see that the 1980s and 1990s distributions are wide and tall, with substantial mass in the upper range indicating that long-form lyrics were common in those decades. The 1990s in particular shows the widest spread, likely reflecting the dominance of hip hop and RnB in that era which, as seen in the genre analysis, tend toward higher word counts. From the 2000s onward the distributions become progressively narrower and more bottom-heavy.

This decade-level word count signal is potentially useful as a feature for the classifier, though as noted in the genre analysis, it may partially reflect the shifting genre composition of each decade rather than a pure temporal trend in songwriting style.

Sentiment by Decade

VADER sentiment score by decade. Scores range from -1 (most negative) to +1 (most positive). A decline toward negative sentiment in recent decades may reflect shifting lyrical themes.

Repetition Ratio by Decade

Repetition ratio by decade, proportion of lines that are duplicates within a song. Higher repetition reflects more chorus-driven, hook-heavy song structures.

Rhyme Density by Decade

Rhyme density by decade, proportion of line endings that share a rhyme sound with another line. Captures how structured and rhyme-driven lyrics are across eras.

Language Distribution by Decade

Detected language distribution by decade. The rise of Spanish-language tracks from the 2000s onward directly reflects the growing mainstream presence of Latin music in the corpus.

Time Traveler Map

Songs that are misclassified across decades — particularly modern songs predicted as vintage — are highlighted in gold below. This interactive UMAP is computed on the full corpus; use the dropdown to filter by true decade or classification status.

Full-corpus UMAP colored by classification status. Gold ‘time travelers’ are 2010s/2020s songs whose lyrics the model reads as 1980s/1990s. Filter by decade or status using the dropdown.
